fields.why: The 23-case series only describes its cases (symptoms, timing, pool time) with a single attack rate among pool users and no group, period or exposed-vs-unexposed comparison; chlorine-log and inspection counts are compliance counts, not comparisons.

The median 24-hour onset interval is a measure of the illness's own course, which can make the outcome continuous, but it is reported once and not compared; whether the pool-link claim rests on it is a judgment call.
